name: hakka-node-framework-servers-example
description: hakka-node's root export (register/startCapture) wired into Express, Fastify, Hono, and raw node:http — each demo prints its own captured records and proves x-hakka-trace correlation, no inspector UI required.
//overrides: The hakka-* packages aren't published yet, so hakka-node uses a file: dep and the transitive pair it depends on (hakka-core, hakka-bridge) is overridden to the same directories — same pattern as examples/next-fullstack. This example lives outside the root workspace on purpose (packages/* only matches direct children of packages/, not this nested examples/ dir), so it resolves hakka-node the way a real npm consumer would. Install with npm, not bun — bun lays file: deps out as per-file symlinks and next-fullstack's README flags the same issue for Turbopack; npm is the safer default here too.
